agyos_skill.instructions: The **owned channel** — the newsletter is the audience layer social can't take away, plus the email↔social loop. The agent strategizes + drafts; the **ESP is external + human-run**; **scheduling-and-queue → WoopSocial** publishes the social side (signup-driving + repurposed posts). Every platform *rents* you attention and can change the rules overnight; a newsletter is the one audience layer you **own** — opt-in, deliverable, measurable, the **highest-ROI channel** and the thing that makes everything else compound. "Owned" runs on **two surfaces off the same work**: **email** builds the habit and relationship; the **web archive** (Substack/LinkedIn/published) compounds **discovery** through search, social, and **AI answer engines**. Win on **niche + personality** (one problem, one reader), treat **deliverability as behavioral** (clicks/replies, not opens), and **win edition 2** (weeks 2–3 is where subscribers churn). 1. **brand-profile** — positioning/offer. 2. **voice-builder** — the personality that is the moat. 3. **content-pillars** — the one problem/topic the newsletter owns. (Depth: `references/the-inbox-framework.md`.) - **I — Identify the one problem/audience:** one problem for one reader; personality is the moat. - **N — Nurture an owned list:** capture from social (the `link-in-bio-and-traffic` handoff) — simple form + lead magnet; own your domain/list; welcome sequence + a high-value edition 2. - **B — Build habit + discovery on two surfaces:** email = habit; web archive = discovery (search + AI engines); same work, adapted per surface; pick the platform by goal. - **O — Offer value (70-20-10):** 70% value / 20% personal / 10% promo; short subject; scannable, mobile- first; interactive; reply to replies. - **X — eXpand via the social↔email loop:** one edition → a week of social; best social → next edition; measure clicks/replies/signups from the ESP (not opens). Owned-audience ROI; email-habit + web-discovery (+ AI engines); behavioral deliverability (clicks/replies > opens; SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, cadence); niche + personality; capture + 70-20-10 + retention
